newsitem.title: LATVIA: LIEPAJA METAL TO DECIDE ON BOURSE LIST.
newsitem.headline: LIEPAJA METAL TO DECIDE ON BOURSE LIST.

text.p: Liepaja Metalurgs, currently in the process of applying for a bourse listing, said on Wednesday that its acting board also plans to decide on which list to go for on Thursday.
"We are currently in consultations with the central depository and, provided we have all the necessary documents by tomorrow, the board will decide on the issue on May 29," Terentjev said.
Most analists expect the company to apply for the secondary list of the Riga bourse.
